newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICAN SUPERSPORT SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICAN SUPERSPORT SCORES.

text.p: Scores on the second day of South African Supersport series cricket matches on Saturday:
In East London: Border 400 (Peter Kirsten 173 not out). Griqualand West 177-5 (Piet Barnard 52 not out).
In Paarl: Free State 254 and 98-1. Boland 264 (Bryan Baguley 77, Kosie Venter 6-96).
In Johannesburg: Natal 407 (Jonty Rhodes 137, Clive Eksteen 5-83). Transvaal 217-6 (Ken Rutherford 87 not out).
In Port Elizabeth: Eastern Province 432-9 declared (Louis Koen 87, Mark Rushmere 66, Kepler Wessels 58, Eldine Baptiste 50, Steve Elworth 4-95). Northern Transvaal 152-2.
